senses.gloss:
फलकक्ष

PHALAKAKṢA . A yakṣa. This yakṣa was a member of the court of kubera. (Śloka 16, Chapter 10, Sabhā Parva)

फलकीवन

PHALAKĪVANA . A sacred place. Once the devatās started practising severe austerities at this place and it lasted for a long time extending to thousands of years. From then onwards this became a holy place. (Chapter 83, Vana Parva, Śloka 86).

फलौदक

PHALAUDAKA . A yakṣa. This yakṣa lives in the court of kubera. (Chapter 10, Sabhā Parva).

फल्गू

PHALGŪ . A holy river. If one visits this place one would get the benefit of doing an aśvamedha. (Śloka 98, Chapter 84, Vana Parva).

फल्गुन

PHALGUNA . Another name of arjuna. arjuna was born in the Uttarāphalgunī constellation in a mount of the Himālyas. So he was called phalguna and also phālguna. (Śloka 9, Chapter 44, virāṭa Parva).

फाल्गुन

PHĀLGUNA . A month (March). It is so called because the phalgunīnakṣatra yoga occurs in that month. He who gives away as gift his meal for a time of the day will become more loved by his wife. Not only that, the Purāṇas declare that such a man would attain Candraloka. (Chapter 109, Anuśāsana Parva).

फल्गुतन्त्र

PHALGUTANTRA . The father of sagara. During the old age of phalgutantra the Haihayas led by Tālajaṅghas attacked ayodhyā and drove out the royal family from the palace. phalgutantra fled from the palace with his wife and stayed in the āśrama of aurva. The King died before long. The queen who was pregnant then delivered a son in due course and he became the celebrated sagara. (Chapter 3, brahmāṇḍa purāṇa).

फलोदक

PHALODAKA . A yakṣa of the court of kubera. (Śloka 16, Chapter 10, Sabhā Parva).
